label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The demo store answered HTTP 500 and Add to cart never finished, with a mouse too (checked by hand). Not counted as an accessibility result.

reclassified.why: The demo store answered HTTP 500 and Add to cart never finished, with a mouse too (checked by hand).

findings.problem: After pressing Enter on a product link nothing is announced and the page tree stays the same; I had to use read to find out the new page had loaded (page title changed only later).
Product page shows no price and no size or color choice anywhere, so I cannot tell what I am buying or its cost.
After Add to cart the button became disabled Loading... and stayed that way across many reads; no confirmation, no error, and Cart stayed at (0), so I could not tell whether the item was added.
Cart control is a button containing a link both named Cart (0); activating it only set expanded with no cart contents or dialog reachable by Tab, focus moved on to the Clothing link instead.
Chino Pants, Puffer Jacket and Serving Plate are all Out of stock, a disabled button, and the home and product lists give no hint of stock before opening each one.
Same as Hoodie: Add to cart switched to disabled Loading... permanently, no announcement of success or failure, Cart stays (0); I could not reach checkout.
The Product Information and Shipping & Returns headings each contain an unnamed button, so I cannot tell what they do.
